name: mycodechecker
description: MyCodeChecker for the editor: bugs, vulnerabilities, code smells, security hotspots and taint flows as you type, with quick fixes, rule descriptions (Korean / English) and connected mode to a MyCodeChecker server.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Connected mode and custom core paths are read only in trusted workspaces.

mycodechecker.language.description: Language of diagnostics, hovers and rule descriptions (auto follows the VS Code display language).

mycodechecker.rules.inactive.description: Rule keys to switch off locally, e.g. "js:var".

mycodechecker.rules.active.description: Rule keys to switch back on although the connected quality profile deactivates them.

mycodechecker.exclusions.description: Glob patterns (workspace-relative) that are not analyzed, e.g. "**/generated/**".

mycodechecker.qualityProfile.description: Quality profile id or name on the server (connected mode). Empty = all profiles, like a server scan.

mycodechecker.analyzeOnChange.description: Analyze while typing (debounced). Off = on open and save only.

mycodechecker.analyzeWorkspaceOnStart.description: Analyze the whole workspace at startup so cross-file findings (taint across files) appear.

mycodechecker.debounceMs.description: Delay after the last keystroke before re-analysis.

mycodechecker.connectedMode.enabled.description: Use the quality profile and issue statuses of a MyCodeChecker server.

mycodechecker.connectedMode.projectKey.description: Project key, id or name on the server. Empty = matched by folder path.

mycodechecker.connectedMode.token.description: Bearer token. Prefer the "MyCodeChecker: Set Server Token" command, which keeps it in the OS secret store.

mycodechecker.connectedMode.refreshMinut.description: How often to refresh the profile and issue statuses (0 = only on start).

mycodechecker.corePath.description: Folder of a MyCodeChecker checkout (or its core folder). Empty = the copy bundled in the extension.

mycodechecker.nodePath.description: Node.js executable for the language server. Empty = the runtime that runs VS Code.

mycodechecker.trace.server.description: Log language server traffic in the MyCodeChecker output channel.
